verdict.rationale: BILL provides an official MCP server, but it is explicitly scoped to API documentation interaction for AI coding tools (Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Desktop), not a full-featured MCP server exposing BILL's actual AP/AR/S&E operations or data to agents. Missing for 10: an official MCP server that exposes live BILL functionality/actions (not just docs), independent hands-on confirmation of it working, and clarity on scope/coverage of exposed endpoints.
